exclusions.reason: Collected before the _BASE_WRIST_CAMERA_NAME_MAP fix in scripts/model_servers/lerobot_server.py. WidowX/bridge has no wrist camera, and the previous positional camera assignment let the lone real (exterior) frame be consumed by the `left_wrist_0_rgb` slot, leaving `base_0_rgb` -- the slot these checkpoints treat as the main view -- empty, with `right_wrist_0_rgb` filled by a duplicated frame. The policy was therefore looking at the scene in a slot it was trained to treat as a wrist closeup.
exclusions.evidence: Camera-slot convention confirmed against openpi's own reference input adapters (physical-intelligence/openpi, src/openpi/policies/{droid,aloha}_policy.py): base_0_rgb is always the exterior camera and a genuinely missing camera is omitted, not duplicated. Full write-up in .claude/skills/slava-lerobot-policies/SKILL.md.
exclusions.clears_when: these 56 episodes are re-collected on a GPU machine with the current lerobot_server.py; the fix is already in the code, only the data is stale
exclusions.short_reason: сняты с конфигурацией камер, не соответствующей этим чекпойнтам на WidowX/bridge; требуется пересъёмка
